SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT L.DOCNUM --询价单号 ,L.DOCLIN --询价行号 ,dbo.Optdes('DOCSTA', L.DOCSTA) DOCSTA ,L.ITMNO --产品编码 ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,L.FAC ,T1.OPTDES OPTDES1 ,T2.OPTDES OPTDES2 ,L.ITMVER --产品版本 ,L.STU --库存单位 ,L.UOM --采购单位 ,L.UOMCOE ,L.QTY --采购单位数量 ,L.QTYSTU ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), L.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,L.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,L.NETPRI ,L.CUR ,L.QTY * L.NETPRI AMT ,Iif(L.DOCSTA = '1', '', '1') LDEBFLG ,L.DOCNUM + Cast(L.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) LINKROWID ,L.DOCNUM pid--询价单号 ,L.REMARK LREMARK ,String_agg(Concat(S.BPSNO, ' : ', Format(S.NETPRI, '0.######'), ' ', S.CUR), '; ') AS SUPPLIERS -- 合并供应商报价 ,LSP.BPSNAM + ' : ' + Format(LSP.GROPRI, '0.######') + ' ' + LSP.CUR LATEST ,(SELECT Sum(QTY) FROM PREQUL QUL WHERE L.ITMNO = QUL.ITMNO AND L.ITMVER = QUL.ITMVER AND L.STU = QUL.STU AND L.UOM = QUL.UOM AND L.UOMCOE = QUL.UOMCOE AND L.DOCNUM = QUL.PINNUM) SUMQULQTY FROM PINQUL L LEFT JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = L.ITMNO LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON BPS.BPSNO = L.BPSNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T1 ON ITM.TSICOD1 = T1.OPTID AND T1.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD1' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT T2 ON ITM.TSICOD2 = T2.OPTID AND T2.OPTTYP = 'TSICOD2' LEFT JOIN PINQUS S ON L.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM AND L.DOCLIN = S.DOCLIN LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS1 ON BPS1.BPSNO = S.BPSNO LEFT JOIN(SELECT TOP 1 L.ITMNO ,H.BPSNO ,H.CUR ,BPS2.BPSNAM ,GROPRI FROM PORDLIN L LEFT JOIN PORDER H ON H.DOCNUM = L.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS2 ON H.BPSNO = BPS2.BPSNO WHERE L.DOCSTA = 2 ORDER BY L.CRETIM DESC) LSP ON LSP.ITMNO = L.ITMNO WHERE L.DOCNUM = '{0}' GROUP BY L.DOCNUM ,L.DOCLIN ,L.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMNAM1 ,ITM.ITMNAM2 ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,ITM.ITMSIZE ,L.ITMVER ,L.STU ,L.UOM ,L.UOMCOE ,L.QTY ,L.QTYSTU ,L.REQDAT ,L.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,L.NETPRI ,L.CUR ,L.DOCSTA ,L.REMARK ,T1.OPTDES ,T2.OPTDES ,L.FAC ,LSP.BPSNAM ,LSP.GROPRI ,LSP.CUR
